_comment: M4 invite events (Kimi C). Kind social_invite: venue_label + adults_only are load-validated and consumed by A's pending/applier; the resolve applier enforces the 18+ gate on accept even if content forgets it. All options free; decline always legal.

events.title: Birthday Party
events.text: {person:host} is having a birthday party at the rec centre and has asked me to come, promising cake and questionable music.

choices.label: Go to the party
choices.outcome_text: I went to the birthday party with a gift and left with cake on my shoes and a genuinely good time.

choices.label: Send your regrets
choices.outcome_text: I sent my regrets to the birthday party with a gift and a polite note, and heard about the cake second-hand.

events.title: Study Group Invite
events.text: {person:host} has invited me to join their after-school study group at the library, snacks apparently provided.

choices.label: Join the session
choices.outcome_text: I joined the library study group and actually learned things between the snacks; an efficient sort of fun.

choices.label: Not this week
choices.outcome_text: I begged off the study group that week and studied alone, which was quieter and only slightly less effective.

events.title: Extra Practice
events.text: The club captain {person:host} has invited me to an extra practice session before the big meet.

choices.label: Train with the club
choices.outcome_text: I went to the club's extra practice and trained until my legs filed a complaint; the captain nodded approval.

choices.label: Skip this one
choices.outcome_text: I skipped the club's extra practice and rested, watching the meet approach with mixed confidence.

events.title: After-work drinks
events.text: {person:host} has invited me to drinks with the team after shift on Friday at the pub around the corner.

choices.label: Go for one drink
choices.outcome_text: I went for after-work drinks at the pub with my team and left after one, cheerful and exactly as charming as one drink allows.

choices.label: Beg off politely
choices.outcome_text: I begged off after-work drinks with a polite excuse and a quiet night, and nobody held it against me.

events.title: Book Club Night
events.text: {person:host} has saved me a seat at book club, where apparently this month's book divided the room into armed camps.

choices.label: Take the saved seat
choices.outcome_text: I took the saved seat at book club and defended an unpopular opinion about the ending until I was outnumbered and happy.

choices.label: Skip this month
choices.outcome_text: I skipped book club that month and read the book alone, forming my unpopular opinions in private.

events.title: House Party
events.text: {person:host} is throwing a house party and has told me to bring nothing but opinions and comfortable shoes.

choices.label: Go to the party
choices.outcome_text: I went to the house party and stayed until the opinions ran out, which took considerably longer than expected.

choices.label: Send your regrets
choices.outcome_text: I sent my regrets to the house party and had an early night, which I described to no one as 'self-care'.
